who: Peter John Bakewell, historian of colonial Latin America, SMU emeritus; PhD Cambridge.

evidence.says: SMU records Peter Bakewell in its History Department from 1999 to 2011, retiring as professor emeritus.

SMU identifies Peter Bakewell as Kahn Chair in History Emeritus, specializing in colonial Mexico and Latin America.
The authority expands P. J. Bakewell to Peter John and records Peter Bakewell as the author of Miners of the Red Mountain.

notes: SMU employment covers the 2009 student; degree, name variants and colonial field agree with the candidate.
